name: Mythic Improved Two-Weapon Fighting (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You strike with two weapons as easily as with one.

Prerequisites: Dex 17, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Mythic Two-Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6, 5th mythic tier.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you may make one attack with your primary weapon and one with your off-hand weapon. When you make an attack of opportunity, if your primary weapon hits you may also make an attack with your secondary weapon as a free action.
